description: Jean Dubuffet was a proponent of art brut, an expressive aesthetic inspired by the spontaneity he perceived in art created by makers outside of Western artistic traditions. Although this work was never intended to be displayed outdoors or scaled up to an urban setting, it dates to a time when Dubuffet was in high demand for such work. In 1984 a related work of his, Monument with Standing Beast, was constructed for the State of Illinois Center.
title: The Forest (La forêt)
